requirements.text: The website shall include a section for High School Courses to show recommended curricula for high school students interested in CS and related careers.
The website shall provide an internal search function for the Get Real site.
The website shall provide an external search function for CS related outside sites.
The website shall include a listing with links to professional organizations such as ACM, IEEE, and key sub groups.
The website shall provide RSS feeds of current CS information.
The website shall include an Ask a Grad or Prof FAQ section.
The website shall include a section regarding the value of a CS minor for students in other professions.
The website shall be compatible with IE, Firefox, and Netscape browsers.
The system shall track and evaluate the hits and time spent on the website.
The system shall implement input sanitization and output encoding for all user-submitted content in the 'Ask a Grad or Prof' FAQ and blog sections to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

The system shall collect and store user analytics in compliance with applicable student privacy regulations (e.g., FERPA), ensuring that no personally identifiable information (PII) is captured without explicit consent.
The system shall enforce role-based access control (RBAC) for all administrative and content-editing functions, requiring unique credentials and multi-factor authentication for privileged access.
The website shall load the main landing page in under 2 seconds for 95% of requests under a load of 500 concurrent users.

The system shall implement an anonymized analytics solution that logs page views and session duration, compliant with FERPA and state privacy regulations, with data retained for a maximum of 24 months.
The website shall implement HTTPS for all traffic, utilize secure headers (CSP, HSTS), and ensure all CMS administrative access is protected by multi-factor authentication.
The system shall utilize a Content Delivery Network (CDN) to serve video assets to ensure consistent playback quality across diverse geographic locations.
The website shall achieve a page load time of under 2 seconds for 95% of requests under normal load conditions.
The hosting infrastructure shall support a minimum of 500 concurrent users streaming video content without degradation in playback quality.
The analytics tracking implementation shall not increase page load latency by more than 100ms.
